body_lead: Bihar Plans To Use AI To Reconstruct The Mundeshwari Temple, India's Oldest Functional Shrine The BHDS started gathering and documenting scattered archaeological remains last month after obtaining permission from the ASI, which protects and maintains the existing temple. Patna: The Bihar government is considering using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to restore the ancient Mundeshwari Temple located on a hill in Kaimur district, and believed to be the oldest functional Hindu temple in the country.
